title: 3 North Lexington

services.name: Vineyard & Tasting Room
services.desc: Expect a serene experience at 3 North Vines Croswell whether you're with a large group or on an intimate date. The owners, Nathan and Kristi, will be there to greet you and share their knowledge of wine to ensure you pick the perfect flavor for your palette. If wine isn't your preferred libation, 3 North is always introducing new hard ciders and sangrias to please any palette, or you can order a flight and try it all! Pair your specialty 3 North drink with a variety of cheese or chocolate plates, a freshly baked french bread basket, snacks, or "the big board" filled with all of our goodies. blurb: Plan a visit to our tasting room, one of the top attractions near Croswell and Lexington. You’ll find tasting flights of wine and hard cider, refreshing sangrias and frosé, plus a selection of charcuterie boards featuring items grown in our gardens. Our tasting room is open-air when the weather permits, so dress for the season.
